test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I saw some / children playing happily / below the shade / of a tree
solution:
The erroneous part is **option 3) i.e. ‘below the shade’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **‘below the shade’.**
 
• Here we need to replace the preposition '**below**' with '**under**'.
 
• **Use of** **Under**- it is used to refer to a position or place covered by something.
 
• Example:
 
 
• Ram hid my books **under **the bedcover.
 
 
 
• Therefore, changing the preposition '**below**' to '**under**' makes the sentence correct.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**

 

**Correct sentence:**__ *I saw some children playing happily **unde**r the shade of a tree.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ** Use of Below**- it is used to refer to something at a lower position or level.
 
• Example:
 
 
• *​Just **below **the pocket was a stain.*
